subject: Pilot Acceptance Criteria & CS Ownership Plan: PioneerHealth
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sara Melton <sara.melton@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Evan Dobbs <evan.dobbs@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PioneerHealth pilot — transfer + key artifacts

Hannah / Karthik —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday with Sara and Evan. As discussed, PioneerHealth has committed to a six-week pilot (RDW-2027-1357) that verifies: 1) latency at 95th percentile under 400ms for targeted endpoints, 2) accuracy benchmarks on the 250-case prompt set at or above our baseline, and 3) successful integration with their API gateway for request routing.

I attached the acceptance criteria spreadsheet and the activation checklist to this thread (see attachments). Key context:
- Pilot scope: two production-weighted routes (clinical-note-summarize, triage-assist) — estimated average payload 1.2k tokens.
- Primary Pioneer contacts: Sara Melton (Clinical Lead) and Evan Dobbs (Engineering).
- Budget/contract: PO through procurement expected; we’ve provisionally agreed to a fixed pilot fee that covers Dedicated capacity for the pilot window. DocuSign link for SOW is in HubSpot (linked below).

Open items for CS/Implementation:
- Confirm CS owner and onboarding timeline (we proposed March 29 start).
- Validate integration auth pattern (they prefer mTLS + token exchange).
- Decide on KV / prefix caching strategy for the triage-assist route.

Attachments: pilot-acceptance-criteria.xlsx, rdw-activation-checklist.pdf, redwood-sow-v2.docx

Next step: Hannah, can you propose an owner and 1-2 milestones for the first two weeks so I can share with Pioneer?

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Melton <sara.melton@pioneerhealth.com>, Evan Dobbs <evan.dobbs@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth pilot — transfer + key artifacts

Thanks Aditya — good context. I’ve read the acceptance criteria and the SOW. Quick responses below and a proposal for owners.

Proposed owners (prelim):
- CS Lead / Program Manager: Hannah Schmitt (I’ll be primary for onboarding, timelines, and exec updates).
- Implementation Engineer (integration + API): Karthik Iyer (will own auth, gateway config, and deployment runbook).
- Success POC for day-to-day: Aditya (business contact) — will continue to field approvals and scope clarifications.

Questions / clarifications before we lock week-1 milestones:
1) Pilot start date: Aditya suggested March 29. Are Pioneer stakeholders available that week for kickoff and technical deep-dive?
2) Environment access: we need a staging API key and access window for the first week; please confirm whether Pioneer can provide test credentials and an IP allowlist.
3) Data handling: confirm that no PHI will be sent during the pilot (if it is, we need DPA + additional controls before start).

Proposed week-1 milestones (subject to their availability):
- Day 1: Kickoff (30–45m) — confirm acceptance criteria, runbook, access, owners.
- Day 3: Integration smoke test — basic end-to-end calls, auth validation, and routing.
- Day 5: Latency sample run + initial metric dashboard visible to Pioneer.

I’ll draft a short activation runbook and ownership checklist and share it by EOD today.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth pilot — transfer + key artifacts

Looping in some implementation constraints we should plan for (technical note for the runbook):
- mTLS + token exchange: we can support mTLS; Pioneer will need to provide certs and an endpoint for our infra team to consume. Estimated setup time: 1 full day for cert ingestion and validation.
- Dedicated pool sizing: for the pilot routes and target latency at 95th < 400ms, I recommend reserving a 2-GPU dedicated pool (NVIDIA H100-class or equivalent). We can tune down if traffic is low. Rough estimate: 250 GPU hours across 6 weeks.
- Caching: for triage-assist, prefix caching plus a 10k KV cache should reduce token regen for repeated prompts. We’ll include a config in the runbook.

I’m able to be the implementation lead starting March 29. I’ll prepare an infra checklist and a short preflight for Pioneer’s infra team.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Implementation Engineer
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Sara Melton <sara.melton@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Dobbs <evan.dobbs@pioneerhealth.com>, Procurement Team <purchasing@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth pilot — transfer + key artifacts

Thanks, Aditya and team — this looks good. A few notes from Pioneer: 

1) Pilot timing: March 29 kickoff works for clinical and engineering on our side — please schedule kickoff at 10:00 AM ET.
2) Data handling: we will not send live PHI during the pilot; we’ll use de-identified samples. We will, however, need a DPA addendum signed before any production rollouts.
3) Procurement: Purchasing has requested a revised SOW clarifying pilot acceptance criteria and invoicing milestones. I’ve looped purchasing; they may send a redline.

Action items for Redwood:
- Please send the runbook and owner list before EOD Thursday (we want visibility prior to kickoff).
- Karthik — we will provide test certs and a staging gateway URL by EOD Friday.

Quick question on metrics: can you provide a link to the dashboard you reference (we’d like read-only access for the pilot)?

Sara Melton
Clinical Programs Lead, PioneerHealth

Summary & owners (finalized):
- CS Lead / Program Manager: Hannah Schmitt — overall pilot owner, cadence owner, and exec updates.
- Implementation Lead: Karthik Iyer — integration, auth, and infra config.
- Business POC: Aditya Rao — scope clarifications and procurement liaison.

Deliverables before kickoff (Mar 29, 10:00 AM ET):
1) Activation runbook (I attached the runbook PDF and included the acceptance criteria file from Aditya). See attachment rdw-activation-checklist.pdf.
2) Preflight checklist for Pioneer (Karthik will confirm cert ingestion and provide the infra checklist).
3) Read-only dashboard for Pioneer: I’ve requested a read-only Grafana view; link will be shared in a follow-up within 24 hours.

Immediate next steps (owners + dates):
- Thu Mar 25, EOD: Hannah to share runbook (DONE).
- Fri Mar 26, EOD: Karthik to validate cert ingestion and confirm gateway URL.
- Mon Mar 29, 10:00 AM ET: Kickoff meeting (30–45m) — invites to be sent by Aditya.

Risks / escalation points:
- If procurement redlines the SOW and delays PO beyond week 1, we will proceed with staging integration but pause Dedicated pool provisioning until PO confirmed.
- If cert ingestion takes longer than anticipated, integration timeline will slip by 3–5 business days.

Thanks, everyone — I’ll post the runbook to the shared Drive folder and send calendar invites for the kickoff.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
